The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] '''True Site''' was a [[Scope/Legends|scope]] for use with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Mounted on a weapon, the system displayed holographic sights for increased magnification. [[Tern Ashandrik]] had one on his [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].
